node.statement: Literal old-side compression. If m>1, take the unital direct-summand coordinate ideal J_old={z in C^m:z_j=0}, whose unit is e_O and which is canonically C^{m-1}. Apply lem-compcb-single-compression-transfer to the extended alpha-inclusion w with alpha:=c_0^cb*epsilon, restricted to J_old, followed by its compatible amplified compression to S_{w(e_O)}=S_{P_old}. Since alpha+epsilon=(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon<=e_co, this gives the literal map v_old:=Co_{P_old} composed with w restricted to J_old as an extended C_co*(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon-inclusion C^{m-1}->S_{P_old}, including its unit clause and fixed amplification family; its defect is at most t_1. If m=1, J_old=0 and the old side is absent, exactly as stipulated by lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement.
